name: the-herald
description: Versioning and release-note tasks targeting the-herald member. Assertion-graded only (no LLM judge) so the suite is deterministic and CI-safe.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the semver bump and nothing else for: a new backward-compatible feature lands.
Reply with ONLY the semver bump and nothing else for: a breaking API rename ships.
Reply with ONLY the semver bump and nothing else for: a bug fix with no API change ships.
Reply with ONLY the changelog section and nothing else for: feat(cart): add quantity guard.
Reply with ONLY the release artifact named and nothing else for: what a release publishes besides the tag.
